name: What are the main building code requirements for garage conversions?

mainEntity.name: What are the main building code requirements for garage conversions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Conversions must meet minimum ceiling heights (7 ft), natural light (8% of floor area), ventilation (4% openings), insulation per energy code, heating to 68°F, and proper electrical outlets every 6 ft along walls.
